name: ARMS
title: A staff portal for Agape Academy International School
description: A secure staff system for Agape Academy International School, with staff sign-in, teacher account requests and an app that installs on phones and desktops.
summary: A secure staff system for Agape Academy International School, in the school’s own colours.
overview: ARMS is the staff system ZIIV designed and built for Agape Academy International School, the Christian school in Pantang West, Ghana, whose website we also delivered.
Staff sign in with their staff ID or email, new teachers can request an account, and the whole system can be installed as an app that opens full screen from a phone’s home screen.

scope.name: Staff sign-in
scope.text: Secure access with a staff ID or email, and password recovery.

scope.name: Account requests
scope.text: New teachers request an account instead of being set up by hand.

scope.name: Installable app
scope.text: Opens full screen from the home screen on phones and desktops.

scope.name: School branding
scope.text: Designed in Agape Academy’s own colours and identity.

standing: Live and in use by the school’s staff.
ownership: A client project. ARMS was built for Agape Academy International School, which owns its brand and content.
